sections.heading: The idea
sections.body_md:
When two materials touch in equilibrium, their potentials (measured relative to intrinsic silicon) differ, and that difference is the **contact potential**. For a PN junction it is the **built-in potential** \(\varphi_{bi}\), the step between the n-side potential and the p-side potential.

Each side's potential comes from the Boltzmann relation, so \(\varphi_{bi}\) depends on the log of the doping product. Heavier doping on either side increases it, but only logarithmically. Contact potentials also appear between metals and silicon and between gates and substrates. Around any closed loop they sum to zero, which is why a voltmeter reads 0 V across an unbiased diode.

sections.heading: Key equations
sections.body_md:
\[ \varphi_{bi} = \varphi_n - \varphi_p = V_{th}\ln\frac{N_D}{n_i} + V_{th}\ln\frac{N_A}{n_i} = V_{th}\ln\frac{N_A N_D}{n_i^2} \]
With \(V_{th} = kT/q = 26\ \mathrm{mV}\) and \(n_i = 10^{10}\ \mathrm{cm^{-3}}\).
Rule of thumb: \(\varphi_{bi} \approx 60\ \mathrm{mV}\times\log_{10}\dfrac{N_AN_D}{n_i^2}\).

sections.heading: Worked example
sections.body_md:
For \(N_A = 10^{15}\) and \(N_D = 10^{18}\ \mathrm{cm^{-3}}\):
\[ \frac{N_AN_D}{n_i^2} = \frac{10^{33}}{10^{20}} = 10^{13} \]
\[ \varphi_{bi} = 0.026\ln(10^{13}) = 0.026\times29.9 \approx 0.78\ \mathrm{V} \]
The rule of thumb gives \(13\times60\ \mathrm{mV} = 0.78\ \mathrm{V}\). ✓

sections.heading: Common pitfalls
sections.body_md:
- Forgetting to square \(n_i\).
- Subtracting the two side potentials in the wrong order, giving a negative \(\varphi_{bi}\).
- Thinking a voltmeter can read \(\varphi_{bi}\).
- Expecting \(\varphi_{bi}\) to double when doping doubles; it only rises by about 18 mV.

sections.heading: Where this leads
sections.body_md: Contact potentials set the depletion width of a junction and the flat-band voltage of a MOS capacitor. The same 60 mV per decade bookkeeping applies to metal and polysilicon gates. A quick estimate with the rule of thumb is usually accurate to within 10 mV, which is good enough to sanity-check any longer calculation.
